method: Thirty-three recipient-specific passes. Every pass must verify, narrow, correct, preserve a falsifier, classify an exclusion, or improve routing/actionability. Compatibility with the hypothesis alone is not a PASS.

passes.finding: ODNI/NCSC/MI/NIC is appropriate for integrated strategic warning and counterintelligence questions spanning foreign influence, network control and collection gaps.
NCSC-Safeguarding-Our-Future@dni.gov is published by ODNI/NCSC for comments/questions; NCSC_Outreach@odni.gov is published as an NCSC outreach contact.
ODNI 2.0 was announced on 2025-08-20, not in 2026. v5 uses the correct date.

ODNI 2.0 says FMIC functions/expertise are being refocused/integrated into MI/NIC and notes NIC/NCSC overlap, while current public site material may still list FMIC. v5 requests routing to current responsible components rather than claiming FMIC is definitively dissolved.

NCSC remains a valid entry point because ODNI 2.0 explicitly says NCSC elements already monitor foreign efforts to influence the American public and NCSC leads integrated counterintelligence/security activity.
v5 states the counterintelligence-specific lead was already submitted to FBI and frames ODNI submission as the integrated strategic-warning/collection-gap question, not duplicate enforcement.
v5 states the platform-specific seed-to-organic hypothesis was separately sent to Meta for first-party telemetry; ODNI receives the cross-domain strategic question.
JUXTAPOSE is absent. FBI-only rule preserved.
Letter asks whether separately demonstrated capability classes could converge; it does not assert the missing coupling as fact.
Crimea/Donbas/occupied-Ukraine source seizure, substitution and route capture retained as high-confidence historical mechanism evidence with Georgia/Syria/Chechnya controls.
Cloudflare-measured rerouting through Russian upstreams retained as strongest modern Internet-path analogue; no extrapolation to arbitrary sovereign countries.
TSPU described as in-path, centrally controlled and broadly deployed domestically based on published technical evidence.
QUIC/SNI evidence retained only as proof of programmable/selective policy behavior, not external deployment.
Regional/mobile shutdowns and mobile deny-except-allowlist mode retained; total loss of every communications channel explicitly rejected.
Russian cross-border control surface may include Russian-side cross-border nodes/lines; foreign TSPU nodes and arbitrary foreign-origin censorship remain NOT_ESTABLISHED.
SORM, commercial DPI, lawful intercept and TSPU remain distinct labels throughout v5.
Foreign Russian-origin SORM/DPI/lawful-intercept deployments retained as confirmed capability substrate, not proof of Russian control.
Russian state remote command of sovereign foreign deployments remains NOT_ESTABLISHED; remote-management architecture is posed as a collection question.
No synchronized multi-country TSPU-like activation is claimed. Narrow-window synchronization requires technical/control linkage and independent replication.
DOJ/FBI 968-account Russian government-operated AI-enhanced bot farm retained as independently attributed tactic-class precedent.
Meta Russia-linked fake-persona/lifestyle/celebrity audience-seeding precedent retained; current Threads accounts are not attributed from precedent alone.
Only the public reply-bait/social-proof/celebrity-engagement wave is treated as observable; hidden coordination remains a hypothesis.
Shared engagement ecosystem is retained; one SMM company/manager/operator behind Baskov+Bilan remains NOT_ESTABLISHED.
Age/gender are treated as persona presentation. Actual minors, targeting and operator identity remain unresolved.
Peer-reviewed adolescent celebrity-reply evidence is used only for mechanism plausibility, not proof of targeting or political conversion.
Early-linked / late-independent cohort contrast preserved as falsifiable discriminator between managed seeding and ordinary virality.
Recurring exculpatory rhetoric is retained as a longitudinal indicator; genuine GGC degradation, sanctions and Western platform restrictions remain mandatory negative controls.
Repeated rare phrases may show propagation/shared framing, but exact quotation/syndication is separated and text similarity alone never establishes a common operator or state direction.
Old account age alone and old media alone are rejected as attribution evidence; chronology, dormancy, topic pivot, synchronized activation or context substitution are required.

U.S. debt and Western-decline/NATO-war corpora are background/preconditioning evidence only. Real fiscal facts are not reclassified as false; narrative-specific population causality remains NOT_ESTABLISHED.
Primary U.S. risk is foreign loss of reach plus degraded/delayed observability while U.S. services may remain healthy; claim that America becomes blind is rejected.

Independent policy timing, normal outages, sanctions/product restrictions, authentic fans, ordinary commercial SMM, local sovereign equipment control and matched clean routes are explicitly preserved as falsifiers.

v5 is organized around an executive assessment, ten concrete collection questions/sections, explicit claim ceiling, official routing, prior scoped submissions and a public repository link. It is send-ready content but remains NOT_SENT pending explicit user approval.

material_changes_from_v4: Removed categorical implication that FMIC is simply a former endpoint; routing now acknowledges current public-website ambiguity and asks NCSC to route to the responsible component(s).
Promoted official electronic NCSC addresses to the submission route.
Added Russian-side cross-border scope with explicit foreign-origin/foreign-node claim ceiling.
Added secondary indicators: technical blame shifting, phrase lineage, old-account repurposing, old-media context substitution and semantic-function shift.
Added explicit note that FBI and Meta have already received their narrower scoped leads.
Expanded falsification contract and independent negative controls.
Preserved platform lead as collection question rather than allowing it to dominate the strategic memo.
explicit_exclusions_from_claim: Russian remote command of sovereign foreign SORM/DPI

routing.request: Route internally to current ODNI components responsible for foreign malign influence, strategic warning and counterintelligence, including NCSC, MI, NIC and/or FMIC as appropriate.
routing.fallback: ODNI Office of Strategic Communications public correspondence
